Title: Best day to gather in person
Detail_lesson: Teams that meet in person some of the time rarely agree on which day earns the travel.

Title: How protected is your focus time right now?
Detail_lesson: Above a certain number of meetings, coordination starts being the work itself.

Title: Core hours worth protecting
Detail_lesson: Distributed teams trade overlap for flexibility, and the right balance is genuinely contested.
Options: None, keep it fully flexible|Two hours a day|Four hours a day|The whole working day

Title: Fastest way to reach you
Detail_lesson: Everyone has a preferred channel and a channel they actually check. They are often not the same.
Options: A chat message|Email|A phone call|A comment on the ticket|Walking over

Title: Cameras should be on by default in team calls
Detail_lesson: Video defaults get set once, early, and are rarely revisited as teams change shape.

Title: How useful are the status updates you read each week?
Detail_lesson: Update cadence is usually inherited rather than chosen.

Title: Learn by doing or read first?
Detail_lesson: Most people have a strong default and assume it is the universal one.
Options: Learn by doing|Read first|Watch someone do it first|It depends on the thing

Title: Should we protect one afternoon a month for learning together?
Detail_lesson: No meetings, no tickets: a talk, a workshop or time on your own.

Title: One tool you would remove
Detail_lesson: Name a single tool and what takes over its job. If nothing does, say what simply stops happening.
Placeholder: The tool, then what replaces it

Title: How should a process be explained to you?
Detail_lesson: The same explanation lands very differently depending on the medium and the reader’s hurry.
Options: A written doc|A short video|A live walkthrough|A diagram
